observations: Large stack of blue plastic tight-head drums.
Two bung openings on top of each drum.
Visible dust and surface scuffs on the exterior.
Several drums in the stack are missing their bung caps (screw plugs).
Watermark 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' visible.

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the embossed food-grade symbol (fork and glass) or manufacturer specifications.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Previous contents cannot be confirmed from exterior photos.
Requires a leak test or video of the drum filled with liquid.
Photo 0 and 1 show multiple drums with open bung holes where caps are missing.

risks.risk: Chemical contamination from previous industrial use
risks.proof: Photo of the original manufacturer label or embossed recycling/food-grade codes.
Photo of the specific drum being purchased with both caps tightly fitted.
Video of the drum filled with water showing no seepage.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the embossed markings on the bottom or top to verify food-grade status.
Photo of the specific drum being sold showing both bung caps are present and intact.
Photo of any original labels that might still be attached to identify previous contents.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as standard 200L plastic drums. Although the 'food grade' claim is unproven and the 'lids complete' claim is contradicted by the photos, the item can be priced at its worst-case value as a used industrial drum missing caps.
